sources.title: Asure 12B original model card, pinned
sources.evidence: Names this exact 12B multimodal instruct release, trained for Turkish and English e-commerce tasks, based on Gemma 3 12B. Explicitly declares license: gemma. The 12B figure is nominal, and no separate active count or reasoning/tool mode is defined.

sources.title: Asure 12B released configuration, pinned
sources.evidence: Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration, Transformers 4.57.3; dense 48-layer Gemma3 text decoder, hidden size 3840, intermediate size 15360, 16 query/8 KV heads of dimension 256, vocabulary 262208, 131072 context. SigLIP vision tower: width 1152, 27 layers, intermediate 4304, 896x896 input with 14x14 patches; vision_use_head=false. No quantization configuration.

sources.title: Asure 12B complete checkpoint index, pinned
sources.evidence: Maps 1065 tensors to five safetensors shards. All indexed tensors were reconciled with bounded headers and the exact configured learned module inventory; index alone was not used as a parameter count.

sources.title: All five Asure 12B bounded shard headers, pinned
sources.evidence: HTTP 206 range requests retrieved only each eight-byte length and bounded JSON header, 143000 bytes total. All 1065 tensors are unpacked BF16 learned weights; every name/shape matches configured modules, offsets are contiguous, tensor byte lengths and complete shard lengths agree. Sum: 12187325040 learned parameters. No packed tensors, scales, stored rotary buffers or duplicate output-head weights.

sources.title: Gemma3 implementation at configured version 4.57.3
sources.evidence: Defines Gemma3 dense attention and MLPs, four layer norms plus Q/K norms per decoder layer, scaled token embedding, final norm, vision tower and multimodal projector. Exact conversion mapping resolves the checkpoint legacy prefixes. LM output shares the token embedding; rotary frequencies and embedding scale are nonpersistent buffers. Projector adds learned 1152x3840 matrix and 1152-dimensional norm.

sources.title: Gemma3 configuration defaults at 4.57.3
sources.evidence: Gemma3TextConfig defaults tie_word_embeddings to true, as used when the exact checkpoint omits that key. Its declared text and vision configurations are instantiated separately.

sources.title: Transformers embedding tying at 4.57.3
sources.evidence: tie_embeddings_and_encoder_decoder consults config.get_text_config(decoder=True).tie_word_embeddings and ties the output to get_input_embeddings. Combined with the exact complete index lacking a separate LM head, establishes counting the shared vocabulary matrix once.

sources.title: SigLIP vision implementation at 4.57.3
sources.evidence: Defines learned patch convolution/bias, position embedding, 27 dense vision layers with attention/MLP biases and layer norms, and final norm. Configured vision_use_head=false excludes pooling-head parameters. Position IDs are nonpersistent buffers.

sources.title: Asure released chat template, pinned
sources.evidence: Formats text/image user content and model responses. No separate reasoning control or tools/schema/assistant function-call/tool-result protocol is defined; their absence does not prove model-wide incapability.

Accessed page structured SocialMediaPosting datePublished is 2026-02-19T15:09:27.935Z. This directly supports February 19 availability, independently of the repository upload date.

sources.title: Original repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public ungated original repository with all five BF16 shards, model/vision config and processor. Safetensors summary 12187325040 independently agrees with the complete module/header reconciliation; card metadata explicitly declares Gemma license.

sources.title: Trendyol official model collections
sources.evidence: Identifies the release in the Trendyol LLM Asure collection, described as a new generation of Trendyol LLM. Gemma3 describes its underlying base architecture; Asure is the developer release family.

sources.title: Later Asure relevance model card checked for exact parent references
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies this exact Asure 12B as the distillation source. The later classifier 311.3M parameters and Apache license describe that distinct model, and are not transferred. No active count for Asure 12B is supplied.

name.note: Readable display spelling of the exact Trendyol-LLM-Asure-12B release.

developer.note: Published and developed by Trendyol; official model card and announcement agree.

family.note: Use the developer-branded Asure release family; Gemma3 remains identified as its base architecture in the description.

release_date.note: Explicit public availability announcement at 15:09:27 UTC confirms the baseline day. February 20 is a later README update, not a new release.

open_weights.note: Original complete checkpoint is publicly accessible without a gate; all indexed headers fetched directly.

license.note: The exact developer model card declares gemma. Do not substitute the Apache license of the later distilled relevance classifier.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete learned count: 12187325040 = 11766034176 language +416866032 vision +4424832 multimodal projector. All five bounded shard headers and 1065 configured names/shapes/dtypes reconcile. Text embedding/output is tied and stored once; no duplicate LM-head tensor. All tensors are unpacked BF16 learned weights and biases; nonpersistent position IDs, rotary frequencies and embedding scale are not counted. The card 12B value is nominal.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model first-party source separately reports or defines active parameters. Dense architecture is not used to equate active and total; vision execution also differs from text-only generation.

architecture.note: Gemma3 dense decoder-only text Transformer with grouped-query attention, alternating local/full attention, dense gated MLPs, and a dense SigLIP vision encoder/projector. No expert routers are configured or stored.

context_window.note: Exact text max_position_embeddings=131072. This is the released configuration limit, not an independent quality measurement.

modalities.note: Native image-plus-text support is explicit in the card, processor example, vision configuration and complete learned tensor inventory. Outputs are text; no native audio/video branch is declared.

reasoning.note: The exact model documents instruction following and business tasks, without a dedicated reasoning mode or binary capability declaration. Clear baseline false rather than infer incapability from absent controls or transfer sibling T1 reasoning claims.

tool_call.note: No exact-model tool calling declaration or shipped full tool protocol was located. General structured extraction is not function calling; clear unsupported false rather than claim categorical absence.

description.value: Turkish-English multimodal instruct model based on Gemma 3 12B, tuned for e-commerce summarization, question answering and structured extraction.
description.note: Reflects developer-stated languages, ancestry, modalities and task focus without asserting comparative performance.

patch.description: Turkish-English multimodal instruct model based on Gemma 3 12B, tuned for e-commerce summarization, question answering and structured extraction.
patch.notes: Complete original checkpoint: 12.18732504B learned parameters, including 11.766034176B language, 0.416866032B vision and 0.004424832B projector weights. Verified all five bounded headers against configured modules; shared text input/output embedding counted once. Active count is undisclosed. February 19, 2026 is supported by the developer public-availability announcement; February 20 is a README update. Configured context is 131072 tokens. Reasoning and tool-calling flags are unverified.

summary: Verifies the complete 12.18732504B multimodal checkpoint and dense architecture, corrects family to Asure, and confirms February 19 public release from the dated developer announcement. Confirms Gemma license, native text/image input and 131072 configured context. Clears unsupported reasoning/tool-call false flags; active parameters remain undisclosed.
